$comment: Building catalogue. Names checked against community wikis. COST TABLES SHIP EMPTY on purpose — upgrade costs change with patches and are not worth guessing. Fill them in under Game Data > Buildings, or use a Custom entry on the Growth Plan for a one-off.

entries.name: Furnace
entries.note: The city's headquarters — its level caps every other building. Past 30 it enters Fire Crystal levels (FC1–FC10), which cost Fire Crystals and, from around FC6, Refined Fire Crystals.

entries.name: Embassy
entries.note: Unlocks at Furnace 8. Governs reinforcement capacity and how many times alliance members can help your builds.

entries.name: Command Center
entries.note: Unlocks at Furnace 10. Raises march capacity and the number of simultaneous marches.

entries.name: War Academy
entries.note: Also where the top troop tier is unlocked by research, rather than by camp level.

entries.name: Crystal Laboratory
entries.note: Refines basic resources into Fire Crystals, a limited number of exchanges per day.

levelSchema.level: number — the level you arrive at
levelSchema.timeMin: number — build time in minutes, before any speed bonuses
